title: Caption editor
intro: Edit your subtitles, check the timing, and download an SRT file.
CUE_TIMING: Use whole milliseconds, in order, with no overlapping cues. End time must follow start time and fit within 99 hours, 59 minutes and 59.999 seconds.
CUE_TEXT: Enter 1–2,000 characters. Remove blank separator lines and control characters.
BODY_TOO_LARGE: The track is too large to export. Split it into smaller tracks.
ASS_TIME_RESOLUTION: Adjust this word to span at least one 10 ms step in the ASS track.
lineBreakBefore: Start a new caption line here
WORD_BREAK: Use a true or false value for the line break.
speaker: Speaker ID
invalidImport: Enter valid JSON containing a words array.
WORD_ALIGNMENT: Import aligned words or enter each word with its start and end time.
WORD_LIMIT: Use up to 1,000 timed words per track.
WORD_CUE_LIMIT: Split this track into parts with at most 500 subtitle cues each.
WORD_TIME: Use ordered, non-overlapping start and end times in whole milliseconds. Each word must have a positive duration.
WORD_TEXT: Enter 1–128 characters of word text on one line.
WORD_SPEAKER: Enter a speaker ID of 1–100 characters on one line.
WORD_SOURCE: The timing source or original provider interval is invalid.
TRACK_MODE: Send one track of cues or words per export.
savedItems: Saved caption projects and brand presets
videoInput: Source video (MP4 or MOV, up to 32 MiB and 2 minutes)
CAPTION_STYLE: Choose a valid caption style and settings.
CAPTION_DOCUMENT: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
CAPTION_SAVE_CONFLICT: This item changed. Reopen the saved version before editing it again.
CAPTION_VIDEO: Choose an MP4 or MOV video up to 2 minutes, 4K and 60 fps.
CAPTION_OUTPUT_SIZE: The result exceeds 64 MiB. Use a shorter clip.
CAPTION_RENDER_BUSY: Your render slots are in use. Try again when a render finishes.
RENDER_TIMEOUT: Rendering took too long. Try a shorter clip.
AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in with a verified Premium account to use styled caption exports and saved projects.
PLAN_REQUIRED: Styled exports and saved caption projects require Premium. SRT is available on your current plan.
